info.name: Farah API v1
info.description:
REST API of **Farah (فرة)**, hourly booking of game and entertainment venues, for the customer app and the provider side.

```
Provider -> Venue (store) -> Activity (priced per hour) -> Resource (Table 3, Lane 1)
         -> time slots -> Booking -> Order -> Payment
```

## Quick start

1. Run **Auth > Request OTP**, then **Auth > Verify OTP (customer)**. The token is saved to `{{customer_token}}`.
2. Run **Auth > Verify OTP (provider owner)** for `{{provider_token}}`.
3. Follow the flow: **Catalog > Search venues**, **Venue details**, **Bookings > Activity availability**, **Create booking**, then **Payment webhook** to pay locally. Requests save the ids the next ones need (`{{venue_id}}`, `{{order_id}}`, ...).

**Log out** and **Delete my account** end the session, so do not include them in a Collection Runner pass.

All values live in the collection variables. `base_url` points at the test server. For a local server use `https://lightgray-mouse-711868.hostingersite.com/api/v1`. The example responses were captured from a real run on demo data, with long lists shortened.

## Basics

| | |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `{APP_URL}/api/v1` |
| Format | JSON in and out. Always send `Accept: application/json`. |
| Auth | Sanctum token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expires after 90 days. |
| Language | `Accept-Language: ar` (default) or `en` |
| Money | SAR, VAT included, JSON numbers. Prices are per hour. |
| Dates | ISO-8601 in UTC, for example `2026-10-09T17:00:00+00:00` |
| Files | Always absolute URLs |

## Headers

| Header | When | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Accept` | Always | `application/json` |
| `Accept-Language` | Always | Anything else falls back to the user's saved locale, then `ar`. |
| `Authorization` | Signed-in requests | Optional on Catalog. |
| `X-Provider-Id` | Provider requests | Optional. Picks the account when the user belongs to several. |
| `X-Signature` | Webhook only | HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. |
| `X-Request-Id` | Optional | On every response. Quote it when reporting a problem. You may send your own (8 to 64 letters, digits or dashes). |
| `If-None-Match` | Optional | On lists with an `ETag`: an unchanged list answers `304`. |

## Responses

```json
{ "data": { "id": 1 } }
```

Actions usually add a translated `message`. Paginated lists add `links` and `meta`, and accept `page` and `per_page`.

Translatable fields return the current language plus both raw values: `name`, `name_ar`, `name_en`.

Statuses are objects, so the app can draw a badge without its own mapping:

```json
{ "value": "confirmed", "label": "مؤكد", "color": "success" }
```

`color` is `gray`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `primary`.

## Time

- Timestamps are stored and returned in UTC.
- Working hours and the slot labels `time` and `end_time` are wall-clock in the business timezone (`Asia/Riyadh`, see `/app/config`). Do not convert them.
- `weekday` is `0` for Sunday to `6` for Saturday.
- `closes_at` at or before `opens_at` means open past midnight.
- Booking holds the slots for `order_payment_timeout_minutes` (default 15).

## Rate limits and repeats

| Group | Limit |
|---|---|
| All API | 120 a minute per user or IP |
| OTP | 5 a minute per IP, 10 an hour per identifier |
| Booking, paying, refunds, ratings, complaints, plan requests | 30 a minute per user |

The same action sent twice within 5 seconds runs once. The repeat gets the first answer with `X-Duplicate-Request: replayed`, or `409 duplicate_request` while the first is still running. Errors are not remembered, so a corrected request goes through.

## Errors

| HTTP | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `{"message", "code": "unauthenticated"}` | Missing, invalid or expired token |
| 403 | `{"message", "code": "account_suspended"}` | User suspended |
| 403 | `{"message", "code": "not_provider_member"}` | Not a member of that provider |
| 403 | `{"message", "code": "missing_permission", "permission"}` | Staff lacks a permission |
| 404 | `{"message", "code": "not_found"}` | Unknown id, or it belongs to someone else |
| 422 | `{"message", "errors": {"field": ["..."]}}` | Validation failed |
| 4xx | `{"message", "code": "<business_code>"}` | Business rule, see below |
| 429 | `{"message", "code": "too_many_attempts", "retry_after"}` | Rate limited |

**Business codes** (422 unless noted):

- **Sign-in:** `otp_throttled` (429), `otp_expired`, `otp_invalid`, `otp_locked` (429), `admin_account` (403)
- **Booking:** `slot_taken` (409), `outside_hours`, `slots_range`, `slot_in_past`, `too_far_ahead`, `resource_unavailable`, `activity_unavailable`, `not_bookable`, `one_venue_per_order`, `max_per_order`, `booking_empty`
- **Payment and wallet:** `order_not_payable`, `already_paid`, `wallet_not_enough`, `invoice_not_available`, `gateway_failed`, `invalid_signature` (401), `invalid_webhook` (400), `amount_mismatch`
- **Refund:** `refund_pending`, `refund_not_eligible`, `order_not_refundable`, `refund_not_allowed`, `invalid_items`, `nothing_left`
- **Reviews and complaints:** `review_not_allowed` (403), `review_too_early` (403), `already_reviewed`, `complaint_closed`
- **Provider account:** `already_registered`, `document_locked`, `sector_exists`, `sector_request_pending`, `sector_not_allowed` (403), `provider_suspended` (403), `provider_not_approved`
- **Plans:** `free_plan`, `plan_inactive`, `subscription_pending`
- **Store:** `venue_limit`, `venue_locked`, `venue_has_orders`, `wrong_status`, `no_activities`, `no_hours`, `activity_has_bookings`, `resource_has_bookings`
- **Team:** `member_exists`, `cannot_edit_owner` (403), `cannot_edit_self` (403), `cannot_grant` (403)
- **Check-in:** `booking_not_found` (404), `booking_used` (409), `booking_finished` (409), `booking_cancelled` (409), `forbidden` (403)

item.description: Passwordless sign-in with a one-time code. A number that has never signed in becomes a new customer.

request.description:
**Auth:** Public

Sends a one-time code by SMS, or by email when `identifier` is an email address. Limits: 5 a minute per IP and 10 an hour per identifier.

A real code has 6 digits and lasts 5 minutes. In `local` and `testing` the fixed code `1234` also works.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | string | Yes | Saudi mobile (`05XXXXXXXX`, `5XXXXXXXX`, `+9665XXXXXXXX`) or an email. Max 120. |

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Auth:** Public

Checks the code and returns a Bearer token. `is_new: true` means the account was just created: show the complete-profile screen and call `PUT /me`.

Only the latest code is valid, and it allows 5 attempts before `otp_locked`. Tokens last 90 days.

**Postman:** saves the token to `{{customer_token}}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | string | Yes | Same value as the request step. |
| `code` | string | Yes | 4 to 8 characters. |
| `device_name` | string | No | Label for the token, default `mobile`. |
| `locale` | string | No | `ar` or `en`. Saved on a new account. |

item.name: Bookings
item.description:
There is no cart. The customer picks slots and books: one request makes one pending order, with the slots held for the payment window, and one payment.

1. `GET /activities/{id}/availability`
2. `POST /bookings`
3. Open `payment.checkout_url` in a web view
4. Poll `GET /payments/{reference}` every 2 to 3 seconds until `paid` or `failed`
5. Show the order. Each booking now has a `code` to draw as a QR, which the venue scans on arrival.

Booking statuses: `pending`, `confirmed`, `checked_in`, `completed`, `cancelled`, `expired`.

request.description:
**Auth:** Public (token optional)

Every slot of the activity on one day, per resource.

Slot `status`: `available`, `booked` (held by a booking or blocked by the venue), `past`, `closed` (beyond `advance_booking_days`). On a closed day `is_open` is false and every resource has `slots: []`.

`time` and `end_time` are wall-clock in the business timezone. Show them as they are.

If the venue is open past midnight, a 01:00 slot belongs to the previous date.

**Postman:** saves the first two free slots to `{{starts_at}}` and `{{starts_at_2}}`.

**Auth:** Bearer token

Answers `201` with `{order, payment}`.

The same booking sent again within 15 seconds answers with the same order and payment. A failed request holds nothing.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `slot_taken` | 409 | A slot is held by someone else. Reload availability. |
| `outside_hours` | 422 | Outside working hours or off the slot grid. |
| `slots_range` | 422 | `slots` outside the allowed range. |
| `slot_in_past` | 422 | The start has passed. |
| `too_far_ahead` | 422 | Beyond `advance_booking_days`. |
| `resource_unavailable` | 422 | Not an active resource of the activity. |
| `activity_unavailable` | 422 | Unknown or inactive activity. |
| `not_bookable` | 422 | Venue not published or provider not approved. |

**Postman:** saves `{{order_id}}` and `{{payment_reference}}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer | Without `lines` |  |
| `resource_id` | integer | No | Without it the first free resource is assigned. |
| `starts_at` | date | Without `lines` | ISO-8601 with offset. Take it from availability as is. Without an offset it is read as business-timezone wall-clock. |
| `slots` | integer | Without `lines` | Consecutive slots, between the activity's `min_slots` and `max_slots`. |
